title: YFPO: Yoked Feature Preference Optimization with Neuron-Guided Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2605.11906v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Preference optimization has become a widely used post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. Existing methods typically learn from preferred and dispreferred responses as external behavioral supervision, while largely ignoring capability-related signals encoded in the model's internal representations. In this work, we study whether such internal signals can provide useful auxiliary supervision for mathematical reasoning. We introduce YFPO (Yoked Feature Preference Optimization), a neuron-guided preference optimization framework that couples response-level preference learning with neuron-level rewards. YFPO first uses AttnLRP to identify math-associated internal features, and then derives an auxiliary reward from the activation margin of these neurons between preferred and dispreferred responses. translated_title: YFPO：基于神经元引导奖励的耦合特征偏好优化
translated_abstract: 偏好优化已成为一种广泛使用的训练后范式，用于提升大型语言模型的推理能力。现有方法通常从偏好与非偏好响应中学习，将其作为外部行为监督，却在很大程度上忽略了编码在模型内部表征中的与能力相关的信号。在本工作中，我们研究这些内部信号是否能为数学推理提供有用的辅助监督。我们提出了YFPO（耦合特征偏好优化），这是一个神经元引导的偏好优化框架，将响应级别的偏好学习与神经元级别的奖励相耦合。YFPO首先使用AttnLRP识别与数学相关的内部特征，然后从这些神经元在偏好与非偏好响应之间的激活差距中推导出辅助奖励。该奖励与标准偏好优化目标相结合，鼓励模型……
tldr: 该论文提出YFPO框架，利用AttnLRP识别数学相关的内部神经元特征，并将偏好与非偏好响应间的神经元激活差距作为辅助奖励与标准偏好优化目标相结合，从而提升大语言模型的数学推理能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes YFPO, a neuron-guided preference optimization framework that uses AttnLRP to identify math-associated internal neuron features and incorporates the activation margin between preferred and dispreferred responses as an auxiliary reward to enhance mathematical reasoning in large language models.
